description: Free commission calculator: what a real-estate agent and brokerage each get from a closed deal, to the cent. Give the sale price and commission percent (or the gross commission in dollars) and optionally the split (like 70/30, agent first), an annual cap, how much of the cap is already paid, a per-deal fee and a referral percent.

cap_cents.description: Annual cap on the brokerage's share, in cents (0 or omitted = no cap)

cap_paid_so_far_cents.description: Brokerage share already paid toward the cap this year, in cents

commission_pct.description: Total commission as a percent of the price, e.g. 3

gci.description: Gross commission income in dollars (instead of sale_price + commission_pct)

per_deal_fee.description: Flat fee the brokerage charges per deal, in cents

referral_pct.description: Referral fee paid out of the gross commission, as a percent

split.description: Agent/brokerage split such as 70/30 (agent first). Default 100/0

name: commission_calculator
